content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Summary:** The APCN 2 Agreement has no governing-law clause; Subparagraph 27.2 (p0263) affirmatively excludes any basis for identifying a municipal or national law, and Subparagraph 27.1 (p0262) makes the Management Committee referral — which may impose arbitration of unspecified method and seat — the "sole and exclusive remedy," foreclosing any court forum. That fails the fallback (no Delaware/California/England and Wales law, no corresponding court) and edges into walk-away territory.

**Cure (preferred level, validated ok:true):**
1. Replaced 27.2 with: "This Agreement is governed by New York law, with exclusive jurisdiction in the state and federal courts in New York County." — this both supplies the missing choice of law/forum and removes the conflicting no-governing-law mechanic.
2. Conformed the one contradictory retained sentence in 27.1 so the committee procedure no longer bars the newly designated courts, while preserving the committee process and its permissive arbitration reference (cross-referenced by Paragraph 20, p0239).
